title: Pattern: the harbour hut breaker trips again
description: Two weeks after the first Slack thread, RAD-254 is dead again and breaker F3 has tripped again. The same workaround is applied: a second occurrence of a recurring problem.
subject: #field-ops

incident.summary: RAD-254 down again at the Turku harbour hut

messages.text: Harbour hut again. RAD-254 dead, and yes, F3 is down again. Foggy all night.
↳ same drill: reset F3 and empty the dehumidifier tray, don't touch the radio
↳ done, radio back up, traffic ok ✅

items.summary: When RAD-254 at the Turku harbour hut is completely dead, breaker F3 has usually tripped; reset it and empty the dehumidifier tray before replacing the radio.
items.diagnosis: the dehumidifier trips breaker F3 in heavy sea fog
items.action: Reset breaker F3 in the cabinet left of the door and empty the dehumidifier tray; check that the radio comes back before replacing it.
items.evidence: seq 3: 'done, radio back up, traffic ok'
